labels.label: T-abs-chronal-neighbour-bridge/0-everywhere
labels.notes: ChronalNeighbours.hasChronalNeighbourEverywhere : C.ChronalNeighbours -> C.HasChronalNeighbourEverywhere, and the latter is definitionally ∀ p, C.HasChronalNeighbour p (LocateExtension.lean:138). No added hypothesis. The extras are true: ChronalNeighbours.nonemptyChronalCones, and ChronalPastNeighbours.Iminus_nonempty_of_mem (a past inside every open V ∋ p). NonemptyChronalCones (∀ x, (C.Iplus ⊤ {x}).Nonempty ∧ (C.Iminus ⊤ {x}).Nonempty) is alpha-equivalent (bound name p vs x) to the inline hI of Causality.Zplus_Zminus_eq_univ (Remarks/BTZPoints.lean:207), K_lorentzien (Remarks/Tarentin.lean:360) and K_eq_I_of_pushUp (Remarks/Tarentin.lean:368).

labels.label: T-abs-chronal-neighbour-bridge/1-minimal
labels.notes: AbsolutelyMinimal.chronalNeighbours_iff [T1Space M] (h : C.AbsolutelyMinimal) : C.ChronalNeighbours ↔ ∀ x, (C.Iplus ⊤ {x}).Nonempty ∧ (C.Iminus ⊤ {x}).Nonempty is exactly the target's sentence, reading I^±(x) in M, which is the library's convention (LadderLocal's chronalPastNeighbours_iff, Zplus_Zminus_eq_univ). The CausallyArcConnected form needs no separation axiom and is true. Both sharpness models are genuine Causality instances and every claimed property holds. globalLine: ≤_U is (x = y ∈ U) ∨ (U = ⊤ ∧ x < y), and ≪_U is (U = ⊤ ∧ x < y), so ≪_U = ∅ for U ≠ ℝ. lt_mono and le_mono hold because V ≤ U and V = ⊤ give U = ⊤ (top_le_iff). I^±_U(x) is Ioi/Iio or ∅, both open. Its push-up, causality (≤_ℝ is the order of ℝ), two-sided causal openness (J^±_U(V) = V for U ≠ ℝ, V ∪ I^±(V) for U = ℝ), non-empty cones, failure of ChronalPastNeighbours at 0 in (-1, ∞), and non-absolute-minimality (through the T1 iff) are all proved. sierpinskiCausality on Prop: ≤_U is (x = y ∈ U) ∨ U = ⊤, and ≪_U is U = ⊤. All fields hold. It is absolutely minimal under the library's definition (Precausality.absolutelyMinimal_iff: the cover member containing False is ⊤ by nhds_false, so each relation is one step in V ⊓ ⊤ = V); the docstring's 'every causality of the Sierpiński space' is argued and true. It has non-empty cones (x ≪_⊤ x), no chronology in {True}, and ¬ T1Space Prop is derived. The SCOPE says it is not one of ETT's spacetimes. The bare forms quantify over X : Type and are correctly refuted.

labels.notes: exists_leaving_of_chronalNeighbours, futureBoundary_union_pastBoundary_nonempty_of_chronalNeighbours, frontier_subset_closure_boundary_of_chronalNeighbours and exists_leaving_of_isOpenEmbedding_of_chronalNeighbours keep every hypothesis of Causality.exists_leaving (LocateExtension.lean:397), futureBoundary_union_pastBoundary_nonempty, frontier_subset_closure_boundary and exists_leaving_of_isOpenEmbedding (:418): PreconnectedSpace where the original has it, CausallyArcConnected, IsOpen, Nonempty, ≠ univ, and the open embedding with Nonempty N and range ≠ univ. Only the boundary hypothesis is replaced, by hN : C.ChronalNeighbours, and each conclusion is verbatim. The local form (LocallyCausallyArcConnected, which is weaker than CausallyArcConnected, together with ChronalPastNeighbours) is correctly disclosed as an extra.

labels.label: T-abs-chronal-neighbour-bridge/3-converse
labels.notes: not_chronalNeighbours_of_hasChronalNeighbourEverywhere_bare : ¬ ∀ X [TopologicalSpace X] [T1Space X] D, D.CausallyArcConnected → D.HasChronalNeighbourEverywhere → D.ChronalNeighbours refutes the converse, and a stronger converse than the target's. The witness is the strict Causal.closedHalfLine (LocateExtension.lean:758; ≤_U / ≪_U are x ≤ / < y with [x, y] ⊆ U on Ici 0). It is causally arc-connected (strict lemma) and hence absolutely minimal, T1 (indeed T2 and second countable, both instances synthesised), and preconnected. Every point has a future (closedHalfLine_hasChronalNeighbour), while I⁻(0) = ∅ (closedHalfLine_Iminus_zero). closedHalfLine_separates_chronalNeighbours states all of this.

findings.what: 'Mathlib synthesises CompactSpace and SecondCountableTopology on Prop, not T0Space' holds only under this module's imports (Causal.LocateExtension, Causal.LadderLocal). With `import Causal` or `import Mathlib`, `#synth T0Space Prop` succeeds (Topology.IsScott.instT0Space); the Sierpiński space is T0. ConnectedSpace Prop is indeed not synthesised. Because the ladder space list says only what the counterexample satisfies, omitting T0 is conservative and changes no classification. The kb sentence would record a false fact.
